text:
incident-bot: ALERT: EdgeWorks (tenant-id: tw-edge-11) in Private VPC is seeing intermittent 502/504 on inference endpoints via the NLB. Auto-detected healthcheck failures for target-group tg-edgeworks-11. Severity=P1. Paging oncall.

alex: acknowledged. I'm oncall. Paging netops and platform-sre. @jamie @suresh can you take network + target group? @lina please prep customer comms.

jamie: looking. NLB (nlb-edge-11) shows many health check failures from 10.0.0.0/16 -> target port 8080. Target group shows 2/4 healthy. Trying curl from control-plane to target IPs.

jamie: ```
curl -sS -I http://10.2.45.22:8080/healthz
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: model-runtime
X-Request-Id: abc123
```

suresh: seeing asymmetric conn tracking on tenant's NATGW — return path seems to be hitting security group rules that only allow established on specific ports. Possible hairpin where NLB healthchecks originate from AZ IPs that are blocked. Checking SGs and route tables.

lina: pinged EdgeWorks (account lead) — they confirm increased 5xxs since ~08:31 UTC, user-facing degraded inference (timeouts). Asking for ETA for mitigation and whether we should failover to standby pool.

alex: decision: do quick isolation mitigation first (least blast radius). If that fails, route DNS weight to standby region for tenant. Jamie/suresh, list exact SG rules you'll change and I will approve. Keep changes reversible.

jamie: plan A (safe, fast): add temporary inbound rule to sg-tenant-11 allowing healthcheck CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 on TCP 8080 for 15m, then monitor. Plan B: change TG health check port to 9090 (runtime admin) which is responding, rollback after root cause.

suresh: confirming SG shows a deny for ephemeral response range 1024-65535 from NLB IPs. That blocks healthcheck responses because service tries to initiate return on ephemeral. Propose add egress rule on sg-tenant-11 to allow ephemeral back to 10.0.0.0/16 for 15m.

alex: approve temporary SG changes (both inbound healthcheck and ephemeral egress). Jamie, make the SG change and post the exact CLI. Keep change to 15min TTL.

jamie: applying change now. ```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-tenant-11 --protocol tcp --port 8080 --cidr 10.0.0.0/16 --description "temp allow nlb hc"
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-tenant-11 --protocol tcp --port 1024-65535 --cidr 10.0.0.0/16 --description "temp allow return traffic for nlb hcs"
```

ops-oncall: FYI — I'm creating a rollback ticket to revoke rules after 15m and add to postmortem checklist.

jamie: SG change applied across AZs. Waiting for healthchecks to stabilize.

jamie: healthcheck success rate improving: tg-edgeworks-11 now 4/4 healthy. Internal curl shows 200 OK: ```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain
X-Node: runtime-7
```

lina: informing EdgeWorks: "We've identified a transient network rule interaction in your VPC that blocked NLB healthcheck return traffic. We applied a short-lived rule to restore connectivity and are monitoring. Estimated impact: ~25-40% requests failing from 08:31–08:39 UTC. We're keeping you updated." They asked for note in postmortem.

alex: marking incident as mitigated. Keep monitoring for 30m. Suresh, please dig deeper into why ephemeral return ports were restricted — likely config drift or automation policy.

suresh: preliminary root cause: tenant bootstrap automation created a restrictive egress SG for compliance; NLB healthchecks use AZ-local IPs and require return ephemeral ports. We'll add a guardrail to detect this SG pattern for tenants with NLBs.

jamie: scheduling rollback in 10m to remove temporary rules and observe. Rollback command ready.

jamie: rollback applied. Re-checking health: targets remain healthy 4/4, 200/200 on /healthz. No more 5xx spikes in last 5m.

lina: customer update sent: confirmed mitigation success, asked if they'd like follow-up postmortem. EdgeWorks requested MRT (mitigation runbook tweaks).

ops-oncall: creating incident ticket INC-2026-458 in tracker with timeline, commands run, and action items: 1) add guardrail, 2) update runbook to include SG check, 3) add automated remediation to allow NLB HC return when TG health fails.

alex: thanks team. I'll close after 30m clean window and we'll include this in next retrospective. :thumbsup:
